command.openEmulator: Open the emulator in the editor
command.addDebugConfiguration: Add a GDB debug configuration (cppdbg + task)
config.basicDialect: Which BASIC the `.bas` files of this folder are: `auto` decides by their content (line numbers and what only each one has), `zxv-basic` is the ZX-V ROM BASIC and `zxv-zxbasic` is ZX Basic (Boriel) with `zxv.bas`. For one file, use the command **ZX-V: Choose the BASIC dialect**; for globs, `files.associations`.
config.basicDialect.auto: By the content of each file
config.basicDialect.zxv: The ZX-V ROM BASIC (with line numbers)
config.claimBasFiles: Open as one of the ZX-V BASICs the `.bas` files that VS Code or another extension opened as Visual Basic, `zxbasic` (jsjlogin) or Boriel Basic.
config.basicCheck: Mark the errors of the ZX-V ROM BASIC as you type: each line is checked as `LOAD` reads it, with the ROM BASIC itself compiled to WebAssembly (`zxv-check`). Only syntax: the errors that come up when running, `RUN` gives them.
config.toolsPath: The folder with the ZX-V tools of a release (`zxv-sdl`, `zxv-cli`). Empty: they are looked for on the PATH.
config.sdkPath: The ZX-V SDK folder (`sdk` in the repository). It is passed to `make` as `SDK=...`, as the Makefile of the SDK guide expects.
config.zxbcPath: The ZX Basic compiler with the ZX-V target: `zxbc.exe` of its release or `zxbc.py` (run with `zxv.pythonPath`). Empty: `zxbc` on the PATH.
config.gdbPath: GDB for RISC-V (`riscv64-unknown-elf-gdb`, `gdb-multiarch`...). Empty: the first of those on the PATH.
config.makePath: The `make` used to build C programs.
config.zxbcArgs: Arguments for `zxbc` besides `--arch=zxv` and `-o`. By default `--enable-break` (Esc stops the program) and `-W150 -W170`, which hide the warnings of the libraries (parameters read from ASM, functions not called), `zxv.bas` among them; remove them to see those warnings for your own code too.
config.program: The `.zxv` that C programs build to, if it cannot be guessed (relative to the workspace folder).
config.gdbPort: The port of the emulator GDB server (`--gdb`).
config.reloadOnChange: Load the program again in the editor emulator when it changes (when it is rebuilt or saved).
task.action: make: build with the SDK; zxbc: compile ZX Basic; run: open in zxv-sdl; gdb-server: zxv-sdl waiting for GDB
task.file: The source file (make, zxbc) or the program (run, gdb-server)
debug.program: The program ELF, with the symbols (build/NAME.elf).
debug.zxv: The .zxv to load (by default, the ELF with .zxv).
debug.port: The GDB server port (zxv.gdbPort by default).
debug.sd: The folder used as SD card (by default, the one with the .zxv).
debug.snippet.zxv: Builds, starts zxv-sdl with --gdb and connects GDB (needs the C/C++ extension)
debug.snippet.cppdbg: cppdbg connecting to the emulator, started by a preLaunchTask
